retail-fanout-04.sql:
SELECT
    c.segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)          AS completed_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity), 0)        AS units_returned
FROM shop.orders          o
JOIN shop.customers       c  ON c.customer_id    = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id     = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN shop.returns     r  ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment

WITH completed_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_order_count
    FROM shop.orders o
    JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY c.segment
),
returned_units AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        SUM(r.quantity) AS total_returned_units
    FROM shop.returns r
    JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
    JOIN shop.orders o       ON o.order_id      = oi.order_id
    JOIN shop.customers c    ON c.customer_id   = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(co.segment, ru.segment) AS segment,
    COALESCE(co.completed_order_count, 0)  AS completed_orders,
    COALESCE(ru.total_returned_units, 0)   AS returned_units
FROM completed_orders co
FULL OUTER JOIN returned_units ru ON ru.segment = co.segment
ORDER BY segment

WITH completed_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_orders
    FROM shop.orders o
    JOIN shop.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY c.segment
),
returned_units AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units
    FROM shop.returns r
    JOIN shop.order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    JOIN shop.orders o       ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN shop.customers c    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
    co.segment,
    co.completed_orders,
    COALESCE(ru.returned_units, 0) AS returned_units
FROM completed_orders co
LEFT JOIN returned_units ru ON co.segment = ru.segment
ORDER BY co.segment

    SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct)) AS net_line_value
    FROM shop.order_items oi
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM completed_orders co WHERE co.order_id = oi.order_id
    )
),
shipping AS (
    SELECT SUM(shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fees
    FROM completed_orders
)
SELECT
    nl.net_line_value,
    s.total_shipping_fees,
    nl.net_line_value + s.total_shipping_fees AS total_charged
FROM net_lines nl
CROSS JOIN shipping s
